title: How to book a job
subtitle: from an approved estimate
audience: Office staff booking jobs from approved estimates (made for Stephanie first)
problem: An estimate shows Approved but the job is not on the schedule. She needs to turn the approved estimate into a booked job with a date, time and crew.
intro_say: Here's how to book a job from an approved estimate. It takes seven quick steps.

outro.title: The job is booked.
outro.line: It now shows on the schedule with your crew.

steps.title: Go to Sales and search the estimate number
steps.text: Click Sales in the left menu, then type the estimate number (here 2211) in the search box.
steps.say: First, click Sales in the menu on the left. Then type the estimate number into the search box. Here, it's twenty-two eleven.

steps.title: Open the estimate
steps.text: On the estimate's card, click Preview. In the window that opens, click Open estimate.
steps.say: On the estimate's card, click Preview. In the window that opens, click Open estimate.

steps.title: Click Book job
steps.text: The estimate says Accepted, not booked. Click the dark Book job button on the right.
steps.say: The estimate says Accepted, not booked. Click the dark Book job button on the right.

steps.title: Click a free time on the calendar
steps.text: Click an open spot on the calendar on the right. Start Date and Start Time fill in for you.
steps.say: Now click a free time on the calendar on the right. The start date and start time fill in for you.

steps.title: Assign your crew
steps.text: Scroll down to Assign To and click it. Pick each person working the job.
steps.say: Scroll down to Assign To, and click it. Pick each person who's working the job.

steps.title: Choose whether the customer is notified
steps.text: Leave Notify customer on to send them a confirmation. Turn it off if you'd rather tell them yourself.
steps.say: Leave Notify customer on, and they'll get a confirmation. Turn it off if you'd rather tell them yourself.

steps.title: Click Book Job to save
steps.text: Book Job turns dark once a date and time are picked. Click it to save the job.
steps.say: Once a date and time are picked, Book Job turns dark. Click it to save the job. And that's it. You're done.

privacy_notes: Customer name, address and crew roster were already blurred in the source screenshots. Checked step by step on 2026-11-25: no phones or emails visible; calendar blocks show job types only.
